Text prefix reuse is off without a scope, and image requests with a scope are bound to a feature identity. That is consistent with the T-041 scoping mitigations, and the prose does not show a loosened gate. They state prefix reuse is in-memory and partitioned by scope, and the slot emits no cache receipts. No SSD tier TTL, naming or AAD changes are visible.
